correctness.rationale: For complete strict rankings the domain contains exactly 24^4 profiles. Unique relabeling of the first full ranking maps them bijectively to 24 copies of 24^3 canonical profiles. Every one of the 24 agent orders is simulated and grouped by exact matching tuple, so the positive multiplicity shapes sum to 24. The canonical code compares two independently written full matching counters for every canonical profile; an independently written C++ program directly enumerates all 331776 labeled profiles and reproduces every one of the 57 CSV rows. A third check directly tests Pareto-undominated perfect matchings for every canonical profile. Integer frequencies sum to the full domain; rational mean and variance are rederived. The code and CSV are complete files; no partial or timed-out search is used to claim impossibility. No claim is made for other market sizes.

originality.rationale: This is a complete finite matching-outcome probability-signature census, not the established fact that RSD is strategyproof and ex-post efficient, nor a census of marginal agent-object probabilities, nor a new proof of the general serial-dictatorship/Pareto equivalence. In the closest published 2026 four-agent work the invariant is q-agent-object waste, and in a separate four-agent census it is marginal ordinal inefficiency; neither supplies all four-by-four matching probabilities. A 2004 use of the word signature denotes a priority topological ordering of one matching, not the sorted frequency partition of all matchings. The three-agent probability-shape spectrum is prior work, not a four-agent result. Unindexed equivalent finite tables remain possible; a failed search alone is not proof.
residual_risks: An unindexed computational table, unpublished manuscript, thesis, supplementary material or another terminology for priority-collision partitions may already contain an equivalent n=4 census.

The 1998 original and all possible later supplementary works were not individually read in full; their known general structural theorems do not imply a numeric n=4 histogram without further enumeration.
Finite exhaustive scripts should be independently reimplemented or mathematically audited before treating this as externally independently validated.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial size of RSD ordinal inefficiency is n=4, motivating exact information about its random matching distribution rather than only its agent-object marginals. The full 57-shape spectrum is a natural complete classification of the 24 priority orders and their collisions. Its missing support sizes 13, 15, 17 and 19–23 reveal a qualitative non-contiguous attainable spectrum, and the exact profile counts and witnesses provide a reusable benchmark for outcome diversity of a central allocation rule. Unlike an isolated arbitrary parameter slice, this completely resolves the natural all-profiles four-agent finite question. Its value does not depend on claiming general n results or independent external certification.
